title: IMFAHE: Global Mentoring, Talent Development and Entrepreneurship
description: IMFAHE is a nonprofit that pairs students and professors from partner universities with international mentors in science, engineering and entrepreneurship.

title: Contact - imfahe.org
description: Contact IMFAHE to bring international mentoring to your university, join our talent platform as a student or professor, or become a mentor.

title: Financial Disclosure - imfahe.org
description: IMFAHE Foundation is a tax-exempt nonprofit. Find our Form 990 and Form PC filings with the Massachusetts Attorney General and learn how to donate.

title: Workshops, Symposiums & In-Person Summer Courses - imfahe.org
description: Free IMFAHE Global Mini-Symposiums where world-renowned experts discuss a hot topic each year, from science communication to open science.

title: IMFAHE Connects - imfahe.org
description: IMFAHE Connects is the online community where students, researchers, mentors and professionals worldwide share opportunities and collaborate.

title: International Conferences - imfahe.org
description: Join IMFAHE's free online International Innovation Camp: present your research, share ideas and connect with experts from around the world.

title: International Fellowships - imfahe.org
description: IMFAHE International Excellence Fellowships offer funded internships and research stays at leading universities and organizations worldwide.

title: International Mentor Program - imfahe.org
description: Get one-on-one international mentorship from experts at Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Google and more through IMFAHE's International Mentor Program.

title: IMFAHE Global Academy - imfahe.org
description: 30-hour online Quarter Courses from the IMFAHE Global Academy: build professional, innovation and leadership skills with international experts.

title: Professors' Professional Development (iPDP) - imfahe.org
description: iPDP is an online professional development program that helps professors and researchers at IMFAHE partner universities build careers of excellence.

title: Global Entrepreneurship Competition - imfahe.org
description: The IMFAHE Global Entrepreneurship Competition helps international teams turn innovative ideas into startups, guided by experienced mentors.

title: Venture Building & Entrepreneurship - imfahe.org
description: IMFAHE's Venture Building Program helps Shark Tank winners turn ideas into investor-ready business models, and runs innovation workshops for universities.

title: Who We Are - imfahe.org
description: IMFAHE bridges academia and the global professional world through Ivy League-inspired education, international mentoring and a global talent platform.
